examples.en: The two maps of the Rockies correspond closely.
examples.zh: 这两张落基山脉的地图极为相似。

examples.en: Jack Sumner was a guide and outfitter who ran a trading post in the Colorado Rockies.
examples.zh: 杰克·萨姆纳曾作为向导兼装备店商在科罗拉多落矶经营一家商埠。

examples.en: We took a bus to a ski resort in the Canadian Rockies.
examples.zh: 我们乘公共汽车去了加拿大落基山脉的一个滑雪胜地。
